name: Recital 18
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: Amendment (-aa) in paragraph 1, the following subparagraph is added after the second subparagraph: ‘The Commission shall adopt, in close cooperation with EFRAG and stakeholders, sector-specific guidelines on sustainability reporting to assist undertakings in applying the standards referred to in the second subparagraph to ensure a high level of consistency within the relevant sector.’
